definitions.explanation: The specific words and phrases used in a text or utterance. Refers to the precise choice and arrangement of words, especially when attention to exact expression matters.

examples.japanese: {字句|じく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修正|しゅうせい}する→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧。
⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{字句|じく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ→一つ一つ：27163_hitotsuhitotsu⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the wording of the contract word by word.

examples.japanese: {字句|じく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわり→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧すぎて、⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見失|みうしな}って→見失う：14129_miushinau⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't get so caught up in the wording that you lose sight of the overall meaning.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧ (character) and ⟦{句|く}→句：02137_ku⟧ (phrase). A formal term used when discussing the precise language of documents, contracts, laws, or literary works. Often appears in contexts where exact wording matters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {字句|じく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修正|しゅうせい}する→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧: to revise the wording
- {字句|じく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to be particular about wording
- {字句|じく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧: interpretation of the wording
- {字句|じく}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧: literally, as written
